import json,subprocess,time,os
F=4096;R=2048;K=8
cfg={'version':1,'idle_timeout':1000000000,'packet_limit':1000000000,'prefix_width':32,'rules':[{'id':i,'class':65535,'priority':2147483647,'ranges':[[1,1]]*K} for i in range(R)],'fallback':{'class':0}}
p=subprocess.run(['python3','-I','/app/submission/main.py','compile'],input=json.dumps(cfg).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,check=True);open('/workspace/tmp/program.json','wb').write(p.stdout)
with open('/workspace/tmp/requests.jsonl','w') as f:
 for i in range(F):f.write(json.dumps({'op':'open','flow':i,'time':0})+'\n')
 for t in range(1,8):
  left=F
  while left:
   q=min(1024,left);base=F-left;left-=q
   ps=[{'flow':base+i,'time':t,'source':0,'length':1} for i in range(q)]
   f.write(json.dumps({'op':'chunk','packets':ps},separators=(',',':'))+'\n')
 f.write('{"op":"checkpoint"}\n')
t=time.monotonic()
with open('/workspace/tmp/requests.jsonl','rb') as inp,open('/workspace/tmp/out','wb') as out:p=subprocess.run(['python3','-I','/app/submission/main.py','stream','/workspace/tmp/program.json'],stdin=inp,stdout=out)
print('sec',time.monotonic()-t,'rc',p.returncode,'size',os.path.getsize('/workspace/tmp/out'))
with open('/workspace/tmp/out','rb') as out:
 for line in out: last=line
v=json.loads(last)['checkpoint'];canon=json.dumps(v,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=True).encode('ascii');print('canonical checkpoint',len(canon),'budget',512+8192*F)
